title: Lagrangian correspondences of nonabelian Hodge type and shifted twistor structures
summary: Classical nonabelian Hodge theory identifies Dolbeault and de Rham moduli spaces by providing a real-analytic isomorphism. In this paper, motivated by the Kapustin--Witten theory, we study this correspondence in the more general framework of perfect complexes on proper varieties, paying special attention to the surface case. We establish a Lagrangian correspondence which relates the shifted symplectic geometries by Pantev--Toën--Vaquié--Vezzosi (PTVV) between the derived stacks of flat and Higgs perfect complexes.
